strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: The Rust runtime lets an explicit headless continuation run one already-admitted verification recovery task to the repair proposal review boundary.
Headless recovery execution records bounded continuation decision evidence and replays the task run result without raw prompts, provider responses, files, commands, paths, or environment values.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting persistent_structured_ledger and controlled verification recovery.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can run one targeted already-admitted verification recovery task to the repair proposal boundary.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Direct task.run can run recovery tasks, but it does not bind M18.1 route/provenance, stale progress checks, and continuation replay into one headless runtime contract.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless recovery remains stuck after recovery task admission and external schedulers must translate route metadata into task.run.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M18.1 admitted recovery tasks; M18.2 runs one admitted recovery task. M16 handled later verification retry and M17 handled run-session control.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The existing headless.continue_once method is extended.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Returned route metadata is tied to actual recovery task admission and existing bounded task handles.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: A valid current headless continuation executes an existing verification recovery task and can produce one recovery-scoped patch proposal through existing M8.2 gates.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Moves Brownie from failed verifier recovery admission to repair proposal review without caller-owned RPC switching.
answers.milestone_progress: Completes the next M18 recovery-loop control boundary after recovery admission.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts bounded verification_recovery_run_target evidence with explicit recovery-run authorization
current aggregate progress fingerprint and sequence are checked before recovery TaskRunning
valid recovery target evidence invokes existing M8.2 recovery task.run and returns bounded verification_recovery_repair metadata
the result routes to review_and_authorize_recovery_proposal when the repair gate passes and does not apply the proposal
replaying the same continuation_id returns the same recovery task run result without duplicate TaskRunning, WorkspacePatchProposed, HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded, or terminal task evidence
stale progress, missing recovery-run authorization, stale source fingerprint, malformed target, mismatched provenance, or conflicting continuation evidence fails before task execution

no new RPC, diagnostics wrapper, readiness report, scheduler, automatic apply, verifier retry execution, provider/shell/git/network/service expansion, VSIX policy ownership, or raw data exposure is introduced
next_phase_candidate_notes: After M18.2 merge, assess M18 milestone exit. If another distinct boundary remains, consider bounded headless progression from approved recovery proposal to explicit apply/retry boundary without automatic apply, verifier execution, scheduler, or wrapper-only output.
